# freshdesk_email_settings (Data Source)

The account's email handling settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_email_settings" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `allow_agent_to_initiate_conversation` (Boolean) Whether agents may email a customer without an existing ticket.
- `allow_wildcard_ticket_create` (Boolean) Whether mail to any address on the domain creates a ticket.
- `auto_response_detector_toggle` (Boolean) Whether automatic replies are detected and suppressed.
- `create_requester_using_reply_to` (Boolean) Whether the Reply-To address becomes the requester.
- `email_subject_match` (Boolean) Whether a matching subject threads a reply onto an existing ticket.
- `extended_quoted_text` (Boolean) Whether more of the quoted history is kept on replies.
- `id` (String) Always `freshdesk`; these settings are account-wide.
- `multiple_to` (Boolean) Whether a message with several To addresses creates one ticket per address.
- `original_sender_as_requester_for_forward` (Boolean) Whether a forwarded email's original sender becomes the requester.
- `personalized_email_replies` (Boolean) Whether replies are sent from the agent's own name.
- `prioritize_tickets_by_outlook_importance` (Boolean) Whether Outlook's importance flag sets the ticket priority.
- `skip_ticket_threading` (Boolean) Whether replies always open a new ticket instead of threading.
- `threading_without_ticket_id_check` (Boolean) Whether replies thread onto a ticket without a matching ticket ID.
- `threading_without_user_check` (Boolean) Whether replies thread onto a ticket even from a different sender.
